observations: The original cubic head, pixel eyes and orb remain visually coherent throughout the reviewed fresh/intermediate/mature states. Fresh sidehorns now extend outward visibly with pale caps.

Fly is visibly taller and thinner than balanced, but its overall crown shaft is near-upright/back-swept; only the short terminal cap bends forward. This is a weaker forward apex than the live viewer and remains a first-pass approximation, not an exact silhouette match.

Representative natural/red/twotone/monocolor/ruby/shiny states preserve morphology. Monocolor caps are intentionally lower contrast; shiny highlights were observed only in stills.

Pumpkin conceals head decoration as expected; rabbit parts replace their corresponding features while eyes remain intact. Phoenix/glasses remain attached in the reviewed poses.
